notes: Original normal/skill projectile speeds and Meteorite CircleCollider2D radii are preserved. Unity projectile arcs and artwork remain unimplemented.
Platinum uses a linear elapsed-attack release interval from the talent blackboard; initialization at full charge and complete C# delay-reset dispatch have not been recovered.
Provence S1 uses the original TargetHpRatioToAtkScale template with linear blackboard HP-ratio conversion. The native action implementation and first-attack animation scaling are not frame verified.

Blue Poison second release follows the original triggerDelta and only repeats the first selected target; additionalTimes blackboard dispatch is interpreted from attack@times. Poison is sourceless Arts with source triggerInterval1/firstInterval1, not attack damage.

Meteorite crit uses one chance per original attack and an ATK percentage modifier around the impact, retaining additive ATK arithmetic. Exact passive buff lifecycle and cross-instance priority remain unverified.
Andreana squad aura selects original abyssal faction tags, including herself and bench operators. S2 selection threshold is not rechecked after a projectile has fired.

Blue Poison S1 uncapped animation scaling is retained separately from ordinary maxAnimScale=1. Source poison overrideType=3 uses a source-owned one-second cadence; native enum dispatch remains unverified. Repeated applications extend expiry without resetting the clock; isDamageMissable=0 and periodic ticks reject dodge.

Meteorite S2 DEF reduction applies at impact before damage, corroborated by the independent akdata DPS calculator. Serialized activeBuffs establish impact attachment, not native C# ordering; same-frame executable parity remains unverified. Cast recovery waits for the full source Skill clip and fired projectile lifecycle, including a fizzled primary.
